'''Joseph Bisz''' (also published as '''Joe Bisz''') played the [[2016 Match Play Championship]].<ref name="pc-rem">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2016-match-play-championship/ 2016 Match Play Championship], starwarsccg.org</ref> Earlier, he finished 3rd at the [[July 2001 Ithaca tournament]], according to Jake Rich's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2675" />
